slug: 2025-01-29 Guinea-Bissau launches ENTD.GW national digital transformation strategy (ANG)

facts.fact: ANG reports that the government launched the national digital transformation strategy at a ceremony presided over by Prime Minister Rui Duarte Barros on 29 January 2025, covering 2025-2030 and aimed at economic development, data management, governance and public service.

systems.system: Estratégia nacional para a transformação digital (ENTD.GW)
systems.owner: Ministry of Transport, Telecommunications and Digital Economy with UNDP
